profile.headline: Backend Software Engineer at Transcarent (formerly Accolade) | Java, Spring Boot, AWS, FHIR | Building clinical microservices serving 20M+ members
profile.summary:
Backend software engineer with experience building clinical healthcare systems at
scale. At Transcarent (formerly Accolade), I develop and maintain Java/Spring Boot
microservices on AWS that power care workflows for a platform serving 20M+ members.
My work focuses on event-driven architecture, DynamoDB data modeling, FHIR-compliant
REST APIs, and data pipelines. I've built services end-to-end from schema design
through production deployment, resolved distributed systems problems like race
conditions and duplicate processing, and delivered partner data integrations using
Apache Spark on EMR. I care about writing code that handles edge cases correctly and
building tools that make other engineers more productive.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Backend Software Engineer on the Clinical Platform team, contributing across 8+
FHIR-compliant Java microservices (Spring Boot 3.x, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, SNS/SQS)
serving clinical care workflows for encounters, claims, care programs, tasks,
assessments, and document exchange.

• Designed and delivered a document exchange service end-to-end: DynamoDB schema,
  REST API, status history tracking with validation, configurable suppression logic
  (opt-out windows, time-based delays), and OpenAPI documentation.

• Built core components of the activity summary pipeline: pluggable rule engine with
  a transform rule interface, event-driven summary computation via SNS/SQS,
  parent-child hierarchy evaluation, OpenSearch scroll-based recomputation, EDW
  export pipeline (Kinesis Firehose to S3 provisioned via CloudFormation), and API
  Gateway integration with OAuth permissions.

• Resolved 10+ production bugs in the claims service across multiple sprints,
  including item-level sorting, date range filtering, search field matching, and
  response parsing errors affecting the member-facing mobile app.

• Fixed critical integration bugs including duplicate event processing, field
  corruption on retry failures, and race conditions resolved via pessimistic locking
  patterns in DynamoDB, eliminating 67% of redundant writes.

• Extended the assessment service with new answer type support across 6 iterations,
  fixed validation defects, and cleaned up stale data mappings that caused downstream
  data warehouse ingestion failures.

• Implemented new workflow task types and automated task creation rules triggered by
  assessment response callbacks, including auto-closure logic with configurable
  reason codes.

• Upgraded shared client libraries with major dependency version bumps across 4 major
  versions, added unit test coverage, and migrated CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins v1
  to v2.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microservices · REST APIs · Amazon Dynamodb · Distributed Systems · Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) · NoSQL · Event Driven Programming · Docker · Agile Methodologies · Elasticsearch · AWS CloudFormation · Apache Spark · JUnit · Maven · HL7 Standards

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Backend Software Engineer on the Clinical Platform team, developing and maintaining
Java 17 / Spring Boot microservices on AWS powering a clinical care application used
by care advocates, clinicians, and physicians.

• Built end-to-end partner data ingestion pipelines using Apache Spark on AWS EMR,
  delivering integrations for 4 external healthcare partners from transformation spec
  design through EMR testing to production release and automated scheduling.

• Contributed bug fixes for resolving task rendering defects and
  component lifecycle issues affecting clinician workflows.

• Performed safe removal of stale feature flags (LaunchDarkly) from production
  microservices, reducing dead code paths and deployment risk.

• Migrated search infrastructure from legacy Elasticsearch endpoints to OpenSearch,
  routing all traffic through API Gateway for consistent auth and rate limiting.

• Managed AWS IAM permission sets and S3 bucket policies to support cross-team
  access for new data export workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microservices · REST APIs · Amazon Dynamodb · Distributed Systems · NoSQL · Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) · Event Driven Programming · Docker · Elasticsearch · AWS CloudFormation

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed an internal tool to search, view, add, and copy patient member claim data using GET and POST requests to the ACP Claims Service API for testing purposes.

• Utilized async/await to handle asynchronous operations, improving the efficiency and responsiveness of the app.

• Contributed to bug fixes and enhancements in the company’s main application, InView, using React.js, improving overall user experience and application stability.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained responsive user interfaces using React.js to enhance the athlete and user experience.

• Created a RESTful API with Node.js and Express.js for efficient data communication and implemented robust user authentication and authorization features.

• Managed and optimized a PostgreSQL database, ensuring data integrity, performance, and scalability.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design, and integrate third-party APIs, enhancing the website's functionality and user engagement.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Engineered a full-stack chat conversation data manager on AWS that improved employees’ productivity rate by 60%. Parents and teachers are now able to access student’s data on each subject and converse directly.

• Developed 6 RESTful APIs in Amazon API Gateway to enable GET/POST functionality that uses Lambda functions in the cloud to manipulate data using DynamoDB with CRUD operations. Due to its scalability, the teachers and parents are able to conveniently access chat history for subsequent interactions.

• Set up persistence of data with AWS S3, delivery of static contents accelerated by CloudFront CDN, and secured client-side access control with CORS resulting in a 15% reduction in content loading times. 

• Implemented user management system and sign-in functionalities with Cognito and incorporated IAM to enable secure user registration and managed account permissions.

positions.title: Registered Dental Hygienist
positions.description:
• Administer comprehensive dental cleanings, involving the removal of plaque and tartar.

• Perform in-depth oral assessments and screenings to identify potential dental concerns.

• Provide patients with valuable insights into effective oral hygiene practices and preventive measures.

• Collaborate closely with dentists to devise customized treatment strategies for individual patients.

positions.title: Registered Dental Hygienist
positions.description:
• Conduct thorough dental cleanings, including plaque and tartar removal.

• Perform comprehensive oral assessments and screenings for dental issues.

• Educate patients on proper oral hygiene techniques and preventive care.

• Collaborate with dentists to develop personalized treatment plans for patients.

positions.title: Registered Dental Hygienist
positions.description: Dental Connections is a dental employment agency offering temporary and permanent placement services for dentists, hygienists, dental assistants.

projects.title: AWS Serverless Live Chat System (AWS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, HTML, CSS) Deployed on AWS
projects.description: Developed a web application leveraging AWS services that enables users to sign up, log in, and engage in real-time chat with other users. The project showcases proficiency in AWS cloud services, front-end development, and security implementations.

projects.title: Pupcademy Dog Training (Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, Jinja, JavaScript, Bootstrap) Deployed on PythonAnywhere
projects.description:
• Created and deployed a full-stack dog training application that uses Object-Relational Mapping to filter and search for dog trainers based on the dog's behavior.
• Designed and developed a user login system allowing mapping of individual dogs to their respective accounts for personalized training. Employed SQLAlchemy to store customer data securely on a server-side database.
